svg.text: A Closed Order unit makes 1 attack per model in its front rank, plus 1 per model in the X ranks behind it if it fights with a Reach (X) weapon (shaded models).
Collision: each rank that is not attacking adds 1 bonus Hit (marked +1), unless the unit is engaged on a flank or rear side. An Open Order unit makes 1 attack
per model in base contact and gets no Collision bonus.
